title: Why Bird Flu Keeps Jumping To New Species
hook: Bird flu jumped from birds to cows, and now it's jumping to people.
closing: Two species, two years, still spreading.
question: Does bird flu scare you?

segments.say: 206 million US birds have died from bird flu since 2022, and deaths keep rising.
In 2024, California recorded 738 infected dairy herds, surpassing all other states combined.
Seventy people infected total, with 41 contracting the virus from cows, not birds.
